## 2. Core Architectural Competencies

### 2.1 Autonomous AI Multi-Agent Architectures
- **Orchestration**: Stateful multi-agent graphs using LangGraph, LangChain, and bespoke supervisor-worker state charts.
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: Hybrid dense vector retrieval + sparse lexical indexing, semantic re-ranking, and self-reflective query rewriting.
- **Agentic Loops**: Autonomous task decomposition, self-correction on compile or execution failures, deterministic tool invocation, and token-efficient memory compaction.

### 2.2 Quantitative Trading Algorithms & Financial Engineering
- **Target Market**: Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) floorsheet feeds, broker automated pipelines, and equity microstructures.
- **Regime Switching**: Dynamic clustering (Momentum, Mean Reversion) calibrated to volatility and trend states.
- **Concept Drift Mitigation**: Page-Hinkley cumulative sum algorithm registers rolling statistical residuals to freeze capital allocations under high distribution drift.
- **Risk Sizing**: Fractional Kelly criterion balancing win probability with expected payout to eliminate ruin risk while maximizing growth.
- **Statistical Arbitrage**: Co-integration testing (Engle-Granger) triggering mean-reverting pairs trades (e.g. NABIL vs NICA) on rolling spread Z-scores.

### 2.3 Distributed Systems & Local-First State
- **Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs)**: State-based (CvRDT) and operation-based (CmRDT) synchronization engines.
- **Causality Tracking**: Vector clock increment and comparison logic guaranteeing partial ordering and causal consistency without centralized coordination locks.
- **Conflict Resolution**: Last-Write-Wins (LWW) deterministic tie-breaking combined with state-merging lattices.

## 3. Flagship Production Codebases

### 3.1 Elite NEPSE AI Trading Agent
- **Description**: Institutional-grade self-improving quantitative trading platform crawling live market floorsheets, classifying regime shifts, and executing broker transactions.
- **Stack**: Python, FastAPI, Playwright (headless broker interaction), Scikit-Learn, Redis, PostgreSQL.
- **Architecture Pipeline**:
  `[Live Floorsheet Feed] -> [Regime Classifier] -> [Drift Monitor (Page-Hinkley)] -> [Kelly Sizer] -> [TMS Broker Connector]`
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Prabesh1919/Stockagent-main

### 3.2 AI Autonomous Web Project Manager
- **Description**: Multi-agent software project manager automating sprint breakdown, task dependency graphs, PR review automation, and integration testing suites.
- **Stack**: TypeScript, Next.js, OpenAI API, LangGraph, Tailwind CSS.

### 3.3 Distributed CRDT Simulator
- **Description**: Interactive vector clock causality engine demonstrating real-time mutation, replication, and convergence across independent client nodes under simulated network latency.
